parameters.dialog-language: Russian unless controlling owner/project instructions select otherwise
parameters.model-mechanical: current inherited Codex model configuration; mechanical task classification recorded
parameters.model-routine: current inherited Codex model configuration; routine task classification recorded
parameters.model-judgment: current inherited Codex model configuration; hardest judgment requirement and actual capability assessed
parameters.gate-cadence: per-change exact specification; authentic approved batch scope where expressly granted; result gate separate

ask-owner-structured.mechanism: Use actual structured owner channel and retain real action/artifact/scope evidence.
ask-owner-structured.fallback: Only actual governing absent-mechanism or authentically authorized effective-undelivered session fallback, anchored reason/authority/end trigger; expiry on structured delivery. No generic chat waiver.

plan-mode.mechanism: Use actual host planning mode when explicitly selected.
plan-mode.fallback: Absent host mode: root enforces design-only declared paths and no Code before ready predicate; behavioral boundary, no hard-mode claim.

spawn-role-isolated.mechanism: Authorized parent uses exposed native collaboration with narrow self-contained role inputs within actual slots.
spawn-role-isolated.fallback: Missing actor capability: label sequential self-review; required independence BLOCKED, never invented worker.

model-tier.mechanism: Classify hardest necessary step; use inherited current owner-configured model/effort, leave overrides unset without selection authority; record requested/exposed observed facts.
model-tier.fallback: Unavailable observation/control stays unknown; no settings/provider mutation or claimed model savings.

role-permissions.mechanism: Use actual host filesystem/tool sandbox where exposed plus explicit exact role paths; judges original source/Git readonly and owned scratch without .git.
role-permissions.fallback: Behavioral role restrictions and root scope audit where hard per-role denial absent; disclose gaps rather than claim enforcement.

pre-tool-guard.mechanism: Parent checks scope, authority/effects and denied commands before operations.
pre-tool-guard.fallback: No new executable hook shipped; behavioral tripwire/manual audit cannot claim hard interception.

run-state-persist.mechanism: Single root writer candidate run_state.py schema2 atomic UTF8 .methodology/runs with complete accepted/refused history/current locks.
run-state-persist.fallback: Unreadable/corrupt/old schema ledger blocks dependent continuation; no fabricated replacement/reset.

workflow-orchestration.mechanism: Explicitly authorized root PM/feature-dev dispatches and validates native phases; helper deterministic guards before accepted record.
workflow-orchestration.fallback: No hidden daemon/model launcher; missing required orchestration evidence BLOCKED; inner roles never dispatch.

structured-output.mechanism: Role returns one full current canonical object; parent extraction/type/conditional/semantic checks, package wrapper preserves result unchanged.
structured-output.fallback: If no schema tool, actual JSON extraction/manual validation with one bounded correction; JSON-looking prose alone not enforcement.

skill-loading.mechanism: Explicit full reads of candidate entries and adapter-resolved current owner subjects, complete injection accepted.
skill-loading.fallback: Path reads allowed when skill API absent; missing/truncated/stale/stub/unread required content blocks; no old-cache substitution.

rules-injection.mechanism: Parent supplies full current six-core/role/runtime/target content or exact resolved paths and identity/read conditions.
rules-injection.fallback: Assigned reader fetches missing authoritative bodies; hashes/cards/summaries do not satisfy full adoption.

session-start-hook.mechanism: Arriving parent/role performs explicit Orient against actual target records and declared profile.
session-start-hook.fallback: No automatic hook installation; manual entry/closure assessment with limits and artifacts, not silent-hook proof.

background-command.mechanism: Use exposed yielding execution session for long authorized commands; retain locator/complete streams/exit.
background-command.fallback: Permitted foreground bounded run only if safe, disclose absent background capacity; no scheduler installed.

web-research.mechanism: Available search/page tools for required external facts, primary docs for technical identifiers.
web-research.fallback: Missing access leaves required claims unverified/BLOCKED; internal evidence only where it actually settles claim.

browser.mechanism: Actual documented browser/AX tool for authorized runnable UI; role/name/state readback separate visual review.
browser.fallback: Component/controller tests within true scope; unavailable mandatory live browser criterion remains BLOCKED, no invented snapshot.

worktree.mechanism: Root may obtain authorized isolated implementation checkout preserving existing dirt and one writer per path.
worktree.fallback: Owned complete source copy/export; judges cannot create worktrees or carry .git; isolation claims match observed mechanism.

schedule.mechanism: Only explicit matching owner recurring-work request through an available supported scheduling tool.
schedule.fallback: No scheduling in default package/native smoke; manual requested action without claiming automatic followup.

memory.mechanism: Relevant project records/notes provide pointers; separately authorized external knowledge source only if actually declared and available.
memory.fallback: External knowledge content remains external; no invented local engine or automatic curation/ingest; honest no-match/access limit.

todo-list.mechanism: Track scoped task progress in actual project plan/TASKS through assigned writer.
todo-list.fallback: No extra tracker/system needed; inner actors return evidence to custodian, absent tool does not waive current records.

goal.mechanism: Only explicit owner goal request and available supported goal API.
goal.fallback: Ordinary task outcome resides in project task/plan records; no automatic tool goal or invented revision fields.

code-map-build.mechanism: Actual target Doxyfile/tool build plus current covered-source/config/full own XML/location inspection; separate package map.
code-map-build.fallback: Missing prerequisite owed/BLOCKED; only actual explicit written target prohibition exception, never configured-only waiver.

check-runner.mechanism: Permitted exec with exact plan argv/cwd/resources and full outputs/exit/log audit, direct logic plus real shipped CLI/artifact controls.
check-runner.fallback: Unavailable required runtime proof BLOCKED; command strings/capture/old results not execution.

run-record-access.mechanism: Read actual authorized immutable run artifacts, role originals, receipts/streams/state/identity chronology.
run-record-access.fallback: Missing/truncated/access gaps explicit; do not reconstruct truth or zero costs from absence.

packaging-install.mechanism: Explicit complete co-located source loading, or an authorized complete-repository snapshot installed by Codex plugin CLI with a generated root transport manifest whose skills path is ./implementations/codex/skills/. FRAMEWORK_ROOT is the nested implementations/codex directory; the adapter and neutral owners keep their original relative layout.
packaging-install.fallback: Detached package-only cache copies remain unsupported/BLOCKED. Reinstall a complete accepted snapshot to update a cached install; discovery and binding checks do not prove native behavioral acceptance.

launch-environment.mechanism: Root names actual allowed target/framework/evidence roots, host permissions, autonomy, owned resources and permitted credential-presence checks.
launch-environment.fallback: Missing granted write/tool/resource prerequisite blocks; no credential payload read/provider install/shared teardown.

capability-discovery.mechanism: Read actual exposed tool schemas, concurrency and permissions at entry/each changed host condition.
capability-discovery.fallback: Adapter declarations are a capability map only; no invented host API or observed mechanism from availability.

context-management.mechanism: Sufficient relevant context, complete current required bodies, stable artifact handoff and same-run checkpoint before continuation.
context-management.fallback: After compaction revalidate identities/evidence/ledger; absent content fetched, no run/budget reset or mental-adoption proof.

tracker-integration.mechanism: Only explicitly authorized actual tracker action/capability with retained source provenance.
tracker-integration.fallback: Default tasks remain in actual TASKS/plan; no external message/issue update from package adoption.
